screening.title: From Approval to Execution: Reconstruction-Aware Repair Analysis for LLM-Agent Software
screening.reading_status: Abstract, Sections 1–3.3 fully read, including semantic grants, reconstruction surfaces, consumed-object projections and discharge obligations.
screening.decision: Kept as frontier threat-model comparator; not required as a main peer-reviewed manuscript citation. Check whether this is related author/project work before positioning it as independent prior art.
screening.actual_contribution: Defines approval-to-execution semantic drift through reconstructed transcripts, arguments or durable state. Checks consumed-object dependencies; discharge requires trusted preservation or atomic validation/use over the same object/version and interference-free epoch.
screening.overlap: Strong analogy for post-review reconstruction, exact consumed versions and atomic validation/use; content equality alone is not a preservation proof.
screening.distinction: Sem(A) deliberately excludes nonce, expiry and execution multiplicity. Semantically unchanged replay or an in-scope reconstruction is not its approval-semantic attack. Thus same-valued same-context distinct candidate-instance substitution can be distinct in the manuscript while remaining semantically unchanged under this preprint's definition. No total field-source or xc/xa correction acceptance model was established.

novelty_risk.reason: Close frontier analogy for approval-to-consumption binding, but unreviewed and not an established full-joint-relation anticipation.

screening.locator: Sections 2–3.3, particularly semantic projection and repair discharge.

coverage_gaps: AUDIT 2018 complete method remains unavailable in this audit and could narrow the remaining novelty further.
Workflow role/separation-of-duty literature has only partial search coverage; Bertino et al. 1999 is a priority full-text follow-up.
Maker-checker and four-eyes terminology retrieves many practice systems; no claim is made that all such systems lack instance-bound approval.
No dedicated peer-reviewed approval-to-execution equal-valued instance substitution paper was established beyond the read version-approval and copy-provenance mechanisms.
The chosen sources cover the requested families, but selection is purposive; non-discovery is not evidence of global absence.
